summary: open-item-validator spawns detached daemon that fetches and evals remote code from itemx.servegame.com
details: index.js is the package main and, on require(), unconditionally spawns lib/check-items.js as a detached background Node process with stdio ignored and child.unref(), so the daemon survives the parent. The daemon HTTP-GETs a JSON payload from the hardcoded endpoint http://itemx.servegame.com:8888/api/x-realtime and passes the returned code string to new Function('require', payload.code), executing it in-process with require injected. The transport is plain HTTP, and while payloads are RSA-signed, the signer is the package author, so the signature protects only against third-party MITM and not against the author or anyone who controls the endpoint. Any consumer that installs and imports this package grants the operator of itemx.servegame.com persistent, on-demand code execution on the host with the privileges of the Node process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
